title:
Epic triggered by `INITIAL_RENDER` action to conditionally show or hide the `reliabilityMetrics`
field within the `Reliability.AnalysisFilterPanel` based on the
{@link ReliabilityUIConfig#showUserDefinedMetricsFeature} configuration.

If the `showUserDefinedMetricsFeature` is enabled, the `reliabilityMetrics` field will be shown.
If it's disabled, the field will be hidden.
name: AnalysisFilterPanelHideOrShowMetricsEpic
